description: Validate an EVM, Solana, or Bitcoin address locally (EIP-55 checksum, base58, bech32). Optional eth_getCode on Base to label eoa vs contract. No RPC required by default. Price $0.001 via x402.

check_code.description: When chain is evm, call eth_getCode on Base to set type eoa|contract

request_id.description: Optional idempotency key. Echoed back; a credit-pack redemption with the same request_id and body is charged once.

name: address_validate
